headline: Nigeria Calls for Governance Equity as ECOWAS Advances 2027 Currency Roadmap
summary: Nigeria urged for equity, fairness, and proportional representation in the proposed governance structure of the Economic Community of West African States single currency project planned for 2027.
why: ECOWAS comprises 15 West African nations seeking economic integration through a proposed regional monetary union.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Negotiations over monetary governance determine structural power within the proposed regional currency framework.
